infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Flexa Market uses your camera to take photos and videos of items you want to sell, so buyers can see your products clearly before purchasing.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Flexa Market uses your photo library so you can choose existing photos of items you want to sell and attach them to your listings.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Flexa Market saves photos to your library after you take them for your listings.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Flexa Market uses your location to show you nearby listings and to automatically set the location for items you are selling, helping local buyers find your products.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Flexa Market uses your microphone to record short video clips of items you want to sell, so buyers can get a better view of your products.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Flexa Market uses Face ID so you can sign in quickly and securely without typing your password.
